publisher: UN/CEFACT (UNTDID), listed for EN 16931 by the European Commission
terms: The page states no licence. It is the European Commission's publication of which codes of each list the European eInvoicing standard admits, offered for implementation of EN 16931; the workbook itself says that it lists codes and does not replace the publication of each list by its own publisher. Reuse of Commission documents is generally governed by Decision 2011/833/EU, which the page does not cite. Recorded as an uncertainty in SOURCES.md. The 2026 edition of EN 16931-1 admits one code more than the edition this workbook was published for: the category of national VAT schemes and margin schemes, whose value is N and whose description here is the one the edition's own table gives it, because the workbook of that day does not carry the code.
